title: australias santos acquires additional 33 interest papua lng 2026 09 07
text:
Sept 7 (Reuters) - Australia's Santos (STO.AX)
, opens new tab
 said on Monday it had acquired ​an additional 3.3% stake in the Papua ‌LNG project from France's TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA)
, opens new tab
 for $189 million, increasing its total interest in the venture to 21%.
The ​acquisition is expected to boost Santos' equity ​liquefied natural gas production from Papua LNG by ⁠about 19%, bringing it to around 1.2 ​million tonnes per annum (Mtpa) on a post-State ​back-in basis.
Separately, TotalEnergies transferred operatorship of the Papua LNG project to ExxonMobil's (XOM.N)
, opens new tab
 local arm while reducing its equity ​stake in favour of other joint ​venture partners.
Santos stated that ExxonMobil's combined operatorship of Papua ‌LNG ⁠and the adjacent PNG LNG project is anticipated to enhance operational synergies and bolster project execution.
Completion of Santos' acquisition remains subject to ​the Papua ​LNG project ⁠reaching a final investment decision, which is scheduled for the fourth ​quarter of 2026.
Following the deals, TotalEnergies' ​participating ⁠interest will fall from 29.1% to 20%, ExxonMobil will see its stake rise from 28.7% ⁠to ​34.1%, and Japan's ENEOS Xplora (5020.T)
, opens new tab
 ​will increase its share from 2% to 2.4%.
